title: ORDO: Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve
abstract: arXiv:2610.11294v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Presolve strongly affects mixed-integer programming (MIP) performance, yet learning-based methods only optimize parameter configurations and cannot express the non-commutative temporal dependencies among actions, whose default order is nearly unique on most domains, yet functionally necessary: artificially shuffling the order of the same sequence inflates the tail of the solve-time distribution by up to several-fold. We recast presolve planning as autoregressive sequence generation over a unified atomic action space, moving the decision object to action sequences; we call this framework ORDO---Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve. translated_title: ORDO：面向混合整数规划预求解的操作级轮次感知动态排序
translated_abstract: 预求解强烈影响混合整数规划（MIP）的求解性能，然而基于学习的方法只能优化参数配置，无法表达动作之间不可交换的时序依赖关系——其默认顺序在大多数领域上几乎是唯一的，但在功能上却是必需的：人为打乱同一序列的顺序会使求解时间分布的尾部膨胀高达数倍。我们将预求解规划重新构建为在统一原子动作空间上的自回归序列生成问题，把决策对象转移为动作序列；我们将这一框架称为ORDO——面向MIP预求解的操作级轮次感知动态排序（Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve）。其收益在于跨领域泛化能力：在多个未见过的领域上，它实现了端到端的零样本加速——据我们所知，这是首个针对预求解动作序列的零样本加速——加速幅度因领域而异，且无法用语料库的丰富程度来解释，表现最强的领域在 racing（原文此处截断）后达到了最大的加速。
tldr: 该论文提出ORDO框架，首次将MIP预求解规划建模为统一原子动作空间上的自回归序列生成问题，通过学习操作级的动态执行顺序，在多个未见领域上实现了首个针对预求解动作序列的端到端零样本加速。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ORDO, which reformulates MIP presolve planning as autoregressive sequence generation over a unified atomic action space, achieving the first end-to-end zero-shot speedup for presolve action sequences across multiple unseen domains.
